// coding-misk · Segnale nel rumore
// song composed with sections and tracks: each track plays its clips, switched on by the section lane (1 plays, 0 is silent, values in between fade)
// each .analyze("…") lights up its instrument in the Stage visual
setcpm(96/4)

const SECTIONS = [['Crescendo', 21], ['Crescendo 2', 40], ['Rumore', 4], ['Emersione', 8], ['Pulsazione', 8], ['Fioritura', 8], ['Silenzio', 2], ['Ritorno', 8], ['Dissolvenza', 4], ['Strip', 6]]
const TEMPO = {'Crescendo': 96, 'Crescendo 2': 96, 'Rumore': 96, 'Emersione': 109.71, 'Pulsazione': 109.71, 'Fioritura': 96, 'Silenzio': 96, 'Ritorno': 109.71, 'Dissolvenza': 96, 'Strip': 96}

// section lanes: 1 plays, 0 is silent, values in between fade
const section1 = "<1!21 0!88>"  // Crescendo · 21 bars · 96 BPM · D · Dm
const section2 = "<0!21 1!40 0!48>"  // Crescendo 2 · 40 bars · 96 BPM · D · Dm Dm G G
const section3 = "<0!61 1!4 0.67 0.33 0!42>"  // Rumore · 4 bars · 96 BPM · D · Dm Dm G G
const section4 = "<0!65 0.33 0.67 1!6 0!36>"  // Emersione · 8 (7/8) bars · 96 BPM · D · Dm Dm G G · fades in over 2 bars
const section5 = "<0!73 1!8 0!28>"  // Pulsazione · 8 (7/8) bars · 96 BPM · D · Dm Dm G G
const section6 = "<0!81 1!8 0!20>"  // Fioritura · 8 bars · 96 BPM · D · Dm Dm G G
const section7 = "<0!89 1!2 0!18>"  // Silenzio · 2 bars · 96 BPM · D · Dm Dm G G
const section8 = "<0!91 1!8 0.67 0.33 0!8>"  // Ritorno · 8 (7/8) bars · 96 BPM · D · Dm Dm G G
const section9 = "<0!99 0.33 0.67 1!2 0!6>"  // Dissolvenza · 4 bars · 96 BPM · D · Dm Dm G G · fades in over 2 bars
const section10 = "<0!103 1!6>"  // Strip · 6 bars · 96 BPM · D · Dm Dm G G

// ========== drums ==========
// Crescendo · bars 1-21 · pattern C~2
// Drums · RolandTR808
$: s("[bd ~ ~ ~] ~ [bd ~ ~ ~] ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.8).lpf(1100).crush(9).mask(section1).velocity(section1).orbit(1).analyze("kick")
$: s("~ [sd ~ ~ ~] ~ [sd ~ ~ ~]").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.6).lpf(1100).crush(9).mask(section1).velocity(section1).orbit(1).analyze("snare")
$: s("[hh ~ ~ ~] ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.4).lpf(1100).crush(9).mask(section1).velocity(section1).orbit(1).analyze("hats")
// Crescendo 2 · bars 22-61 · pattern C~2
$: s("[bd ~ ~ ~] ~ [bd ~ ~ ~] ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.8).lpf(1100).crush(9).mask(section2).velocity(section2).orbit(1).analyze("kick")
$: s("~ [sd ~ ~ ~] ~ [sd ~ ~ ~]").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.6).lpf(1100).crush(9).mask(section2).velocity(section2).orbit(1).analyze("snare")
$: s("[hh ~ ~ ~] ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.4).lpf(1100).crush(9).mask(section2).velocity(section2).orbit(1).analyze("hats")
// Emersione · bars 66-73 · pattern A~2
$: s("hh ~ ~ ~ hh ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ hh ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain("<0.3 0.18 0.19 0.21 0.23 0.25 0.26 0.28>").lpf(1100).crush(9).mask(section4).velocity(section4).orbit(1).analyze("hats")
// Pulsazione · bars 74-81 · pattern B~2
$: s("bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.8).lpf(1100).crush(9).mask(section5).velocity(section5).orbit(1).analyze("kick")
$: s("~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.6).lpf(1100).crush(9).mask(section5).velocity(section5).orbit(1).analyze("snare")
$: s("hh ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.4).lpf(1100).crush(9).mask(section5).velocity(section5).orbit(1).analyze("hats")
// Fioritura · bars 82-89 · pattern C~2
$: s("[bd ~ ~ ~] ~ [bd ~ ~ ~] ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.8).lpf(1100).crush(9).mask(section6).velocity(section6).orbit(1).analyze("kick")
$: s("~ [sd ~ ~ ~] ~ [sd ~ ~ ~]").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.6).lpf(1100).crush(9).mask(section6).velocity(section6).orbit(1).analyze("snare")
$: s("[hh ~ ~ ~] ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.4).lpf(1100).crush(9).mask(section6).velocity(section6).orbit(1).analyze("hats")
$: s("cr").bank("RolandTR808").gain(.55).room(.4).mask("<0 1 0!6>").mask(section6).velocity(section6).orbit(1).analyze("fx")
// Ritorno · bars 92-99 · pattern D~2
$: s("bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.8).lpf(1100).crush(10).mask(section8).velocity(section8).orbit(1).analyze("kick")
$: s("~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.6).lpf(1100).crush(10).mask(section8).velocity(section8).orbit(1).analyze("snare")
$: s("hh ~ ~ ~ hh ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ hh ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.4).lpf(1100).crush(10).mask(section8).velocity(section8).orbit(1).analyze("hats")
$: s("sd*14").bank("RolandTR808").gain(saw.range(.15, .75)).mask("<0!2 1 0!5>").mask(section8).velocity(section8).orbit(1).analyze("snare")
$: s("cr").bank("RolandTR808").gain(.55).room(.4).mask("<0!3 1 0!4>").mask(section8).velocity(section8).orbit(1).analyze("fx")
